request.prompt: Create one production candidate bitmap for the Armax Relay Clash 2D fighting-game art catalog, faithfully studying the supplied Mass Effect 2 original game-model reference. Show exactly ONE adult character in ONE outfit, full body from head to complete feet. Isolated on a genuinely transparent RGBA background. No scenery, no floor shadow, no captions, no title, no logo outside the outfit, no border and no multiple views. Detailed realistic original game-model materials under even neutral studio illumination, clear complete silhouette. Three-quarter front view turned toward screen-right, with minimal perspective. Preserve exact anatomy, silhouette, proportions, cut, seams, materials and colors of this specific alternate outfit in the supplied sheet; no modernization or reinvention. Allow at least six percent transparent margin around every extremity. Subject: Mordin Solus, Mass Effect 2, wearing the WHITE/SILVER and BURGUNDY loyalty alternate outfit shown in the supplied five-view full-body sheet. This is the exact pale coat variant, not a black/yellow suit. Very slim tall adult salarian with long narrow neck, peach-brown wrinkled skin on upper head, pale mouth and chin, large dark eyes and unequal natural cranial fins/crest with the characteristic damaged shorter side; preserve that facial structure and asymmetry rather than replacing it with a generic human, lizard or monster. His outfit has a broad smooth pale-silver/white chest yoke that curves across the upper torso, high collar with central burgundy inset, burgundy vertical central torso strip, black upper-arm/torso underlayers, silver shoulder edging, and long smooth pale split coat panels ending around mid-thigh. Match the large oval black recesses in the side coat panels and the pale forearm guards with elongated black oval openings exposing mechanical bracer details. The collar has its very distinctive raised U-shaped support arch BEHIND the neck and two small circular disk terminals projecting to either side, as in the reference; these are costume fixtures, not horns, earphones or an extra head. Thin salarian legs in black underlayers with silver knee/shin supports and long narrow forward-pointing pale boots, match the source's joint layout. Slender three-digit gloved salarian hands hanging naturally beside the body, arms just away from the coat so the construction can be read. No weapon, omni-tool effect, added lab equipment, new symbols or additional characters. Full-body calm neutral character-inspection pose; the shoulder arch and both complete boots must fit inside the transparent margins.
